raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The RTX 5090 CI pool (`1-gpu-5090`) is down. The replacement 8x RTX 5090 machines come from vast.ai, and a standard vast.ai instance is itself an unprivileged Docker container, with `CAP_SYS_ADMIN` and `CAP_NET_ADMIN` removed. So we can't run the usual layout of one Docker container per GPU. The fallback is 8 runner processes in one container, each pinned to one GPU with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`.

A trial run of that layout failed 52 of 52 jobs, all in Install dependencies, because the runners shared state that is normally private to each container:

- `/root/.rustup`: concurrent toolchain installs left `cargo` missing (18 jobs)
- the dpkg frontend lock (6 jobs)
- the kept venv `/opt/sglang-ci-py3.12`, which concurrent installs `rm -rf` and rebuild (3 jobs)

Two more problems would show up once tests run:
- `killall.py` kills every sglang process in the shared `/proc`, including other runners' test servers.
- The `/dev/shm` sweep unlinks other runners' live `cuda.shm.*` and `nccl-*` segments.

## Modifications

Opt in by setting `SGLANG_CI_SHARED_HOST=true` in each runner's environment. Then:
- Each runner gets its own Rust (`CARGO_HOME`, `RUSTUP_HOME`) and uv-managed Python (`UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR`, `UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR`) under `/opt/sglang-ci-runners/$RUNNER_NAME`. These are exported to later steps.
- The kept venv moves to `/opt/sglang-ci-runners/$RUNNER_NAME/venv-py3.12`.
- The `/dev/shm` sweep skips the segment families that have no owner PID in their name.

Always on, and uncontended on a single-tenant runner:
- Host-wide installs run under one `flock` (`/tmp/sglang-ci-host.lock`). This covers apt (apt packages, the nvidia-dkms repair, GDRCopy, protoc, zstd), the system pip/uv bootstrap, and the `/usr/local` and `/opt/gdrcopy` installs.
- `killall.py` skips sglang processes whose `RUNNER_NAME` differs from its own. In a per-runner container every process has the same runner name, so nothing changes there.

Caches (uv, Hugging Face, JIT kernels, cargo target) stay shared, as they already are across the per-GPU 5090 containers, which all mount one `/opt/ci-cache`.

**The second commit is temporary.** `[DO NOT MERGE] Route 5090 jobs to the 1-gpu-5090-vast runners` sends this PR's 5090 jobs to the vast.ai runners so the isolation can be checked on real hardware. It will be dropped before merge.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A, CI infrastructure only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code with pre-commit (ruff format and ruff check on the changed Python files).
- [x] Add unit tests: `test_killall_runner_scope.py`, and a new case in `test_stale_shm_cleanup.py`, both in `base-a-test-cpu`.
- [ ] Update documentation
- [ ] Validate on the vast.ai runners (this PR's 5090 jobs). The trial machines have 32 GB of disk, so `No space left on device` failures are expected and are separate from the isolation.
- [ ] Drop the `[DO NOT MERGE]` commit

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Shared-host isolation
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# SGLANG_CI_SHARED_HOST=true marks a container shared by several runners (one
+# per GPU) instead of one container per runner.
+is_shared_host() {
+    case "$(printf '%s' "${SGLANG_CI_SHARED_HOST:-}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in
+        1 | true | yes) return 0 ;;
+        *) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+}
+
+# Serializes host-wide installs (apt, system pip, /usr/local, /opt/gdrcopy)
+# across runners sharing one host; uncontended on a single-tenant runner.
+# Same path as scripts/ci/utils/{ensure_zstd,install_rust_protoc}.sh.
+HOST_LOCK=/tmp/sglang-ci-host.lock
+with_host_lock() {
+    local lock_fd
+    # Read-only: the file may have been created by root via sudo flock.
+    [ -e "${HOST_LOCK}" ] || : >"${HOST_LOCK}"
+    exec {lock_fd}<"${HOST_LOCK}"
+    flock --timeout 1800 "${lock_fd}"
+    "$@"
+    flock --unlock "${lock_fd}"
+    exec {lock_fd}>&-
+}
+
+isolate_shared_host_runner() {
+    if ! is_shared_host; then
+        return
+    fi
+    SHARED_HOST_RUNNER_ROOT="/opt/sglang-ci-runners/${RUNNER_NAME:?SGLANG_CI_SHARED_HOST requires RUNNER_NAME}"
+    # Toolchains are per-container on per-runner hosts, so give each runner its own.
+    # Caches (uv, HF, JIT) stay shared: per-GPU containers already share ~/.cache.
+    export CARGO_HOME="${SHARED_HOST_RUNNER_ROOT}/cargo"
+    export RUSTUP_HOME="${SHARED_HOST_RUNNER_ROOT}/rustup"
+    export UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="${SHARED_HOST_RUNNER_ROOT}/uv-python"
+    export UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR="${SHARED_HOST_RUNNER_ROOT}/uv-python-bin"
+    mkdir -p "${CARGO_HOME}" "${RUSTUP_HOME}" "${UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR}" "${UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR}"
+    if [ -n "${GITHUB_ENV:-}" ]; then
+        # Self-heal: see install_rustup.sh for context on missing _runner_file_commands/.
+        mkdir -p "$(dirname "$GITHUB_ENV")" 2>/dev/null || true
+        printf '%s\n' \
+            "CARGO_HOME=${CARGO_HOME}" \
+            "RUSTUP_HOME=${RUSTUP_HOME}" \
+            "UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=${UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR}" \
+            "UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR=${UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV" || true
+    fi
+
+    mark_step_done "${FUNCNAME[0]}"
+}

+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.cli.killall import _find_sglang_pids_by_name
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(os.path.isdir("/proc"), "requires /proc")
+class TestKillallRunnerScope(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _spawn_fake_server(self, runner_name):
+        env = {**os.environ, "RUNNER_NAME": runner_name}
+        proc = subprocess.Popen(
+            [
+                sys.executable,
+                "-c",
+                "import time; time.sleep(60)",
+                "sglang.launch_server",
+            ],
+            env=env,
+        )
+        self.addCleanup(proc.wait)
+        self.addCleanup(proc.kill)
+        return proc.pid
+
+    def test_skips_other_runners_processes(self):
+        """Runners sharing one PID namespace must not kill each other's servers
+        at job start; orphans from this runner's own jobs are still found."""
+        own = self._spawn_fake_server("runner-a")
+        other = self._spawn_fake_server("runner-b")
+        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"RUNNER_NAME": "runner-a"}):
+            pids = _find_sglang_pids_by_name()
+        self.assertIn(own, pids)
+        self.assertNotIn(other, pids)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
